'''Crozo Industrial Products''' was a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] design and manufacturing corporation,<ref name="CRFG" /> renowned as a leader in the field of biocomp research and development.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Although their main production lines dealt in [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implants and a host of other similar devices, they also expanded their industry to the development of [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and communications equipment for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and personnel.<ref name="EGWT" /> From their experience with cybernetics, they applied their expertise at microtechnology to the development of a diverse line of [[Comlink|portable communication devices]], and despite its relatively small workforce, the corporation was immensely successful.<ref name="NEGWT" />
